title: Hollywood’s First Live-Action Webtoon Series in the Works With Charlize Theron & Hulu
content:
Manhwa and webtoons have become absolutely massive within pop culture spaces in the past few years, with series like Lore Olympus , Solo Leveling , and Heartstopper becoming popular enough to receive televisio adaptations as well as merchandise and physical publications of their source materials. That trend seems to be continuing as web-based comics become more mainstream, as Deadline recently reported that Hulu plans to adapt The Mafia Nanny , written by Violet Matter with art by shoo, Drawniels, and Roususu with award-winning actor and producer Charlize Theron acting as executive producer on the series.

As of writing, Hulu’s adaptation of The Mafia Nanny does not have an official release date, however, it has been confirmed that the series is still in its early development stages with 20th television. There also haven’t been any details released regarding casting announcements for the series.

The Mafia Nanny Has Quickly Become One Of Webtoon’s Top Series

The Mafia Nanny , written by Violet Matter with illustrations by shoo, Drawniels, and Roususu debuted on Webtoon’s web-comic streaming platform in 2023 . The series follows Davina Diavolo (aka Davina Bonetti), a graduate from the Elite Nanny Association, which has given her a highly refined skillset in cyber security and hand-to-hand combat. She’s hired as a private caregiver and nanny to the Angelini family — specifically, Gabriel Angelini: a tall, brooding, silver-haired man with connections to a powerful mafia family. Gabriel has enlisted Davina to protect and care for his son, Mikey Angelini. While Davina is supposed to detach herself from her personal feelings and devote everything to obeying her boss, she herself has suffered at the hands of the Angelini family.

The series currently has 115 chapters available to read on Webtoon sprawling three seasons. The Mafia Nanny has been a massive success since it originally launched, earning it over 334.2 million views on the platform, as well as 4.4 million subscribers waiting to see where Davina and Gabriel’s story takes them next. The series also has unique “video episodes” complete with voice acting, with Erin Nicole Lunquist as Davina Diavolo and Nico Fragoso as Gabriel Angelini that can be watched on the series’ main page through Webtoon. The series plays heavily with popular tropes found in webtoons, like the famed slow-burn enemies-to-lovers trope, as well as the male lead Gabriel having a “cold on the outside, soft on the inside” personality.

LINE Webtoon Continues To Dominate The Entertainment Industry

It shouldn’t come as a surprise that manhwa and web-comics originating from Webtoon have garnered enough mainstream appeal to be eyed by major production studios, after all, the landscape created by Webtoon has exploded in popularity. The platform exploded in 2018 when Rachel Smythe began streaming her Lore Olympus , which has garnered over 1.7 billion views and won the Eisner Award for best web-comic three years in a row in 2022, 2023, and 2024. For anime fans, there are two extremely recognizable titles that have blown up thanks to the platform: Tower of God and Solo Leveling , both of which have received anime adaptations from highly respected animation studios.

With so many successful titles under its belt, Webtoon has become the largest digital comic platform in the world, maintaining 145 million active users across 150 different countries. Not to mention, over 27 million comic writers and artists publish their work to the site. Webtoon’s approach to “streaming” and reading chapters makes stories extremely accessible, and its approach to promoting full color works makes every up-and-coming title remarkably eye-catching to potential readers. Seeing that The Mafia Nanny will be making its way to mainstream audiences through Hulu’s new live-action adaptation, it’s likely that the popularity of the platform will only grow more over time.

HT – Deadline

title: Hotel Inhumans Anime's 2nd Season Casts Shōya Chiba
content:
The official website for the television anime of Ao Tajima 's Hotel Inhumans manga revealed on Thursday a new cast member for the anime's second season . The website also began streaming a preview video for the first episode of the new season (episode 14 overall), but it is not currently available in the U.S. Shōya Chiba will play Subaru Yoda, a high school transfer student who joins the piano club:

The new season features returning staff, including director Tetsuro Amino at studio Bridge , and Bridge 's Isle studio (which Bridge established as a subsidiary in May 2025) is also credited for production. Shoji Yonemura ( Parasyte -the maxim- , Wave, Listen to Me! , Shaman King 2021) is again in charge of the series scripts, and Shingo Fujisaki ( Let This Grieving Soul Retire! ) is again designing the characters. Haru Yamada returns as the sound director and Koharu ( Charan-Po-Rantan ) is again composing the music.

GAN ( Takanori Iwata ) performs the second season's opening theme song "Rasen" (Spiral), and girl group Phantom Siita perform the ending theme song "Sweet Pea."

Hina Yomiya voices the new character Shiba Kirihara.

The first season debuted on TV Tokyo and its affiliates in July 2025, and ended in September that same year. Crunchyroll streamed the anime as it aired.

The anime stars Yūsuke Kobayashi as Ikurō Hoshi and Hinano Shirahama as Sara Haizaki.

Seven Seas Entertainment is releasing the manga. The company describes the story:

A luxury hotel is required to offer certain amenities. First-rate food, sublime comforts, enchanting entertainment, and...the latest weapons, forged IDs, and body disposal service?! This is a hotel where the guests are professional assassins and its concierges never say no to any request. No matter what their dangerous guests need, the hotel staff are at their service!

Tajima launched the manga in Shogakukan 's Sunday Webry site in June 2021. The manga ended with its 12th compiled book volume, which shipped in September 2025.

title: Fairy Tail Re:Fantasia Manga Miniseries Ends in Next Chapter
content:
This year's 43rd issue of Kodansha 's Weekly Shōnen Magazine announced on Thursday Hiro Mashima 's Fairy Tail Re:Fantasia manga miniseries will end in the next chapter in the 44th issue on September 30.

The miniseries launched in this year's 35th issue of Kodansha 's Weekly Shōnen Magazine on July 29.

The original manga series follows the adventures of the world's most notorious mage guild, Fairy Tail. The manga launched in 2006, and ended in July 2017.

The manga has inspired four television anime , two anime films , several original video anime projects , and spinoff manga . Kodansha USA Publishing releases the original manga and a number of its spinoffs in English.

Mashima and Atsuo Ueda 's Fairy Tail: 100 Years Quest sequel manga inspired a television anime that premiered in July 2024.

Ginolabo's Fairy Tail : Dungeons game launched for Nintendo Switch on January 7. The game first launched for PC via Steam in August 2024.

title: Gachiakuta Drops New Look at Coolest Release Ahead of Season 2 – Watch Trailer
content:
Gachiakuta emerged as one of the best anime of 2025 on Crunchyroll, revolutionizing the shonen anime genre with its dark approach to the medium. The anime adaptation by Studio Bones continued to prove that it was one of the best new anime series of the year with its 24-episode run, which began in the Summer 2025 season and continued through the Fall. From its early episodes, the anime built a solid foundation to establish itself as one of the best new anime series of the year. Crunchyroll further cemented this by crowning it with the title at its awards ceremony. With such an epic season, fans are naturally awaiting the second season.

Fortunately, the new season of the anime has been confirmed, although its release date or even a release window has yet to be announced. That said, the first season of the anime was popular enough to help the franchise expand in other ways. Last fall, as the anime was wrapping up its first season, a game based on the anime was announced by Com2uS . Now, a new gameplay trailer for the game has been unveiled, and the first look at the gameplay perfectly captures what the anime brought to the table, with fans saying it looks like a good adaptation following the gameplay reveal.

Gachiakuta ‘s Game Gets a Promising First Look Ahead of Season 2

The new gameplay trailer unveiled for the upcoming Gachiakuta game, Gachiakuta: Breakout , hints that it will adapt the narrative of the anime and manga. What makes this adaptation actually faithful is that fans will not be able to play as Rudo alone, but as multiple characters, which so far hints at Enjin and Riyo, while confirmed gameplay of Zanka being controlled by a player has also been unveiled. It features Zanka in a boss fight against Jabber in the same state fans saw their fight in during the first season of the anime, which ultimately ends in Zanka’s defeat as Jabber drags him away after poisoning him . This is a major hint that fans will get to see an accurate narrative adaptation.

The gameplay itself is amazing, as it features Zanka using his weapon in close-combat fights with parry and blocking mechanics. This has prompted fans to appreciate that it is not an arena fighter game adaptation, as most anime game adaptations end up being. Meanwhile, it is also hinted that Rudo will employ various trash, as he does in the series, and emerge as a dynamic fighter. If the same could be implemented, fans could get to experience a fun gameplay mechanic with Enjin’s umbrella as his primary weapon, while Riyo’s use of a gun could also suggest ranged weapon mechanics .

Though fans are not appreciating every element, as the game still seems like it needs some polishing, the team could improve it and make the game even more presentable before its release sometime in 2027. Fans hope for a late 2027 release, as it could give the game more time for proper development. Ultimately, this is another win for the Gachiakuta franchise, as the game looks promising and could be something fans enjoy in 2027 until the anime returns with Season 2 sometime in the near future.

title: Ani-One Asia Licenses Hotel Inhumans Season 2, Reincarnated as a Sword Season 2, The Vermillion Mask Anime
content:
Ani-One Asia announced on Tuesday and Wednesday that it has licensed the Hotel Inhumans season 2, Reincarnated as a Sword season 2, The Vermillion Mask , Vertex Force , and Uncle’s Obsession with Cute Things anime. All five anime will debut in October.

Ani-One Asia will stream the second season of the television anime of Ao Tajima 's Hotel Inhumans manga in Brunei, Cambodia, Hong Kong, Indonesia, Laos, Macau, Malaysia, Mongolia, Myanmar, the Philippines, Singapore, Taiwan, Timor-Leste, Thailand, and Vietnam. The anime will debut in Japan on October 4.

Ani-One Asia describes the anime:

Every guest in this hotel is an assassin. Hotel Inhumans —This is a hotel tailored for elite assassins. A top-tier hotel must meet a few requirements. Exquisite cuisine, world-class relaxation, captivating entertainment, plus access to the latest weapons, rock-solid fake identities, and flawless corpse disposal. On the border of death stand two concierges, Ikuro and Sara, who never say, "No." What kind of wishes will they fulfill for the assassins? The jaw-dropping spectacle at Hotel Inhumans is about to begin!

Hina Yomiya voices the new character Shiba Kirihara.

The first season debuted on TV Tokyo and its affiliates in July 2025, and ended in September that same year. Ani-One Asia streamed the anime as it aired in Japan.

Ani-One Asia will stream the second season of the television anime of Yuu Tanaka and LLO 's Reincarnated as a Sword ( Tensei Shitara Ken Deshita ) light novel series in Bangladesh, Bhutan, Brunei, Cambodia, Hong Kong, India, Indonesia, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Laos, Macao, Malaysia, Maldives, Micronesia, Mongolia, Myanmar, Nepal, Pakistan, Palau, Papua New Guinea, the Philippines, Singapore, the Solomon Islands, Sri Lanka, Taiwan, Thailand, Timor-Leste, Tonga, Tuvalu, Vanuatu, and Vietnam. The anime will debut streaming in Japan on September 30, and will debut on television on October 7.

Ani-One Asia describes the anime:

Fran, a young Black Cat girl who was mistreated as a "nameless" slave, meets an intelligent, sentient sword named Teacher and becomes its wielder. Joining the Adventurers' Guild, Fran makes a name for herself as an adventurer while completing various quests. Fran strives to achieve the "evolution". Wanting to grant her wish, Master sets their next destination to the port town. En route, Master and Fran discover a "floating island" and encounter Jean Du Vix, a necromancer aiming to conquer it. Accepting his request, they decide to brave the floating island's dungeon together. However, it turns out to be a deadly labyrinth teeming with undead magic beasts! A new adventure begins for the cat-eared girl and her overprotective sword!

The series stars Ai Kakuma as Fran, Shinichirō Miki as Master, and Yūma Uchida as Jean du Vix.

Shinji Ishihira ( Fairy Tail , Log Horizon , Edens Zero ) returns to direct the anime at at C2C . Takahiro Nagano ( Duel Masters script writer) is writing and supervising the scripts. Atsuko Saitō ( Hitori Bocchi no Marumaru Seikatsu , Wandering Witch - The Journey of Elaina episode animation director) designs the characters. Yasuharu Takanashi is composing the music.

FZMZ performs the opening theme song "Dream of Butterfly" and Hanabie. performs the ending theme song "Baribari Buddy."

The first anime season premiered in October 2022. Ani-One Asia streamed the anime as it aired in Japan.

Ani-One Asia did not reveal region streaming details for the anime adaptation of Dr.Poro and Nabana Naba 's The Vermillion Mask ( Shuiro no Kamen ) manga. The anime will debut in Japan on October 10, and will have two parts.

Ani-One Asia describes the anime:

Resist. Your enemies. Your fate. “The Mask” gives power to those who wear it. At times that means endless possibility, or unimaginable tragedy… Peru, pupil of the legendary mask maker Gaston Roux, becomes controlled by the “Mask of the Warrior God,” and unintentionally kills his friends and even his own master. To prevent this type of tragedy from recurring, Peru swears to destroy all of Gaston's masks around the world. Confronting the sins that he has committed, he embarks on his voyage. Meeting new friends, then confronts powerful foes. The boy continues on. Until the day he can atone for his sins against his master. Thus, this masked battle fantasy commences!

The anime stars:

• Taihi Kimura as Peru d'Arrest

• Yūki Yamamoto as Sonarue Maywood

• Kazuki Ura as Mok Sharib

• Takanori Hoshino as Gouon

• Wataru Komada as Totoque

• Junya Enoki as Zent

• Kazuhiko Inoue as Gaston

• Akio Ōtsuka as Mask of the Warrior God

• Kenji Nojima as Hien

• Aoi Koga as Lasgarl

• Yūki Shin as Clown

• Akihisa Wakayama as Rinne

• Aya Endō as The Mask of Necromancy

• Yui Horie as Master

Tetsuaki Watanabe ( BLUELOCK season 1) is directing the anime at 100Studio (WOW Studio). Gai Hazako is the assistant director. Daisuke Ōhigashi ( Fate/strange Fake ) is in charge of series composition. Hisashi Higashijima ( Mashle: Magic and Muscles ) is drawing the character designs. Fumiyuki Go is the sound director. Arisa Okehazama ( The Apothecary Diaries ) is composing the music.

Ani-One Asia did not reveal region streaming details for the Vertex Force original television anime . The anime will debut in Japan on October 3.

Ani-One Asia describes the anime:

Akira Todo lives a peaceful life with his older sister Haruka and his mother, who runs a cafe. The family, however, harbors a secret. Haruka inherited a power known as "Engine" from her father, and she hides it from others. Akira, on the other hand, did not inherit his father's power and suffers from a complex about his weakness. Amidst this, strange events begin to occur around the world. What is the goal of the enemy approaching Akira and his family? The battle of boys and girls bearing the fate of the universe begins now.

The anime stars:

• Makoto Koichi as Akira Todo

• Kaede Hondo as Haruka Todo

• Ami Koshimizu as Eleanor Northbrook

• Megumi Han as Lala Zudenstein

• Rie Takahashi as Yoko Nishina

Kazuhiro Takamura ( Strike Witches , Vividred Operation ) is directing the anime at SMDE , and is also designing the characters. Gorō Kuji ( Chained Soldier , Peleliu: Guernica of Paradise ) is the assistant director. Kanetake Ebikawa ( Mobile Suit Gundam 00 , Mobile Suit Gundam: The Witch From Mercury mechanical design ) is the "engine designer" and JNTHED ( Mobile Suit Gundam: The Witch From Mercury , 2022 Urusei Yatsura mechanical design ) is in charge of "ENIA design." Takamura is also overseeing the series scripts alongside Masashi Suzuki ( Lord of Vermilion: The Crimson King ; Jack-of-All-Trades, Party of None ). Masahito Onoda ( Brave Witches , Strike Witches: Road to Berlin ) is the chief animation director, and Nobuaki Nobusawa ( Clevatess , Astra Lost in Space ) is composing the music.

Ani-One Asia did not reveal region streaming details for the television anime of Tsutomu 's Ojisan wa Kawaii Mono ga Osuki. (Older Men Like Cute Things) manga. The anime will debut in Japan on October 4.

Ani-One Asia describes the anime:

Mitsutaka Oji is handsome and exceptional at his job, but he secretly has a soft spot for all cute things. While he enjoys the utmost trust of his subordinates at the office, at home he spends his most blissful moments showering affection on his favorite character, "Pugtaro." Living every day in anxious excitement, Oji keeps his huge secret, his love for cute things, strictly to himself. Please enjoy this story of his overwhelming love for Pugtaro and how his daily life begins to shift, step by step, following a certain turn of events.

The anime stars:

• Kazuyuki Okitsu as Mitsutaka Oji

• Miyu Tomita as Pugtaro

• Fūka Izumi as Bosskichi

• Yurie Funato as Anne

• Asami Tano as Carrie

• Hinata Satō as Greapy

• Takuya Eguchi as Kenta Kawai

• Yūki Kaji as Wataru Naruto

• Ayumu Murase as Masumi Nii

• Kaori Maeda as Rio Shigeoka

• Miharu Hanai as Mirai Usuma

• Satoshi Niwa as Haruo Koba

• Mie Sonozaki as Hoho Takebayashi

Tomoe Makino ( The Moon on a Rainy Night ; Kotaro Lives Alone ; Please Put Them On, Takamine-san! ) is directing the anime at LIDEN FILMS . Yū Satō ( Kotaro Lives Alone ; Sorairo Utility ; Please Put Them On, Takamine-san! ) is in charge of series composition. Tomomi Kimura ( Kotaro Lives Alone ) is designing the characters. Takamasa Nakakuki is the art director, while Akira Hashigami is the color key artist. Tomoya Hosaka is the director of photography, while Kiyomi Yamada is the editor. Fumihiko Ōtera is the sound director, and Magic Capsule is credited for sound production. Arisa Okehazama is composing the music. YTE is credited for music production, and Futokoro Gatana is credited for music production assistance.
author: ANN

Atsuko Saitō ( Hitori Bocchi no Marumaru Seikatsu , Wandering Witch - The Journey of Elaina episode animation director) designs the characters. Yasuharu Takanashi is composing the music.
FZMZ performs the opening theme song "Dream of Butterfly" and Hanabie. performs the ending theme song "Baribari Buddy."
The first anime season premiered in October 2022. Ani-One Asia streamed the anime as it aired in Japan.

Ani-One Asia did not reveal region streaming details for the anime adaptation of Dr.Poro and Nabana Naba 's The Vermillion Mask ( Shuiro no Kamen ) manga. The anime will debut in Japan on October 10, and will have two parts.
Ani-One Asia describes the anime:

Resist. Your enemies. Your fate. “The Mask” gives power to those who wear it. At times that means endless possibility, or unimaginable tragedy… Peru, pupil of the legendary mask maker Gaston Roux, becomes controlled by the “Mask of the Warrior God,” and unintentionally kills his friends and even his own master. To prevent this type of tragedy from recurring, Peru swears to destroy all of Gaston's masks around the world. Confronting the sins that he has committed, he embarks on his voyage. Meeting new friends, then confronts powerful foes. The boy continues on. Until the day he can atone for his sins against his master. Thus, this masked battle fantasy commences!

title: Aniplus Asia Airs Simulcast of Reborn as a Space Mercenary, Magical Explorer Anime
content:
Aniplus Asia announced on Tuesday and Wednesday that it will air simulcasts of the Reborn as a Space Mercenary and Magical Explorer anime for the fall 2026 anime season.

The television anime of Ryūto and Tetsuhiro Nabeshima 's Reborn as a Space Mercenary: I Woke Up Piloting the Strongest Starship! ( Mezametara Saikyō Sōbi to Uchūsen Mochi Datta no de, Ikkodate Mezashite Yōhei Toshite Jiyū ni Ikitai ) light novel series will debut in Japan on October 4.

The cast includes:

• Makoto Furukawa as Hiro

• Konomi Inagaki as Mimi, Hiro's love interest

• Anna Nagase as Elma, Hiro's steadfast partner

• Haruka Shiraishi as Serena, a noble's daughter and military officer

• Kana Ueda as Shoko

• Saori Ōnishi as Mei

Norihiko Nagahama ( I've Somehow Gotten Stronger When I Improved My Farm-Related Skills , The Strongest Magician in the Demon Lord's Army was a Human ) is directing the anime at Studio A-Cat . Takamitsu Kōno ( Absolute Duo , Highspeed Étoile , The Beginning After The End ) is in charge of the series scripts. Masami Sueoka ( The Strongest Magician in the Demon Lord's Army was a Human , The Beginning After The End ) is designing the characters. Jin Aketagawa is the sound director. Kenta Higashiohji is composing the music.

FLOW will perform the anime's opening theme song "Unstoppable." Metal band ASTERISM will perform the anime's ending theme song "My Way."

Seven Seas Entertainment has licensed both the light novels and manga adaptation, and describes the story:

When Satou Takahiro is swept away from his ordinary life into the world of his favorite video game, a universe of space battles, interstellar colonies, and danger in the vastness of outer space awaits. Soon, he's living as “Hiro” the mercenary, with a tricked-out spaceship and a babe on each arm! There are space pirates to fight, girls to rescue, and trouble to get into (and hopefully out of). Hiro is going to live his new life to the fullest!

The television anime of Iris and Noboru Kannatsuki 's Magical Explorer light novel series will debut in Japan on October 3.

Yen Press is publishing the light novel series and Yukari Higa 's manga adaptation, and it describes the story:

Living in the world of Magical★Explorer, the legendary erotic game, sounds like a dream. Problem is, I reincarnated not as the lady-killer protagonist with his overpowered cheat skills, but as his unlucky comic-relief best friend!

The anime will star:

• Nobunaga Shimazaki as Kōsuke Takioto

• Ai Kakuma as Ludie

• Saori Ōnishi as Yukine Mizumori

• M.A.O as Nanami

Kazuki Ohashi ( Shadows House ) is directing the anime at WHITE FOX . Satoko Sekine ( TsukiPro the Animation ) is handling series composition. Ryosuke Kimiya ( Grimoire of Zero ) is designing the characters. Kenichiro Suehiro ( Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- ) is composing the music.

ASCA performs the show's opening theme song "Remedy" and the ending theme song "Double Wings."
author: ANN

title: Now That We Draw Anime Reveals First Trailer, January 2027 Release Date
content:
Now That We Draw anime revealed the first teaser trailer, along with new character visuals and a January 2027 release date. Shunsuke Ishikawa is directing the anime at studio ROLL2, with Deko Akao handling the series composition and Hiromi Nakagawa as the character designer. The anime previously revealed a key visual in March. The main voice cast includes:

• Sayumi Suzushiro as Niina Miyamoto

• Ayumu Murase as Yuuki Uehara

You can hear the duo in action in the new trailer below.

The romantic comedy follows Yuuki and Niina, two aspiring manga creators who enter into a secret fake relationship in order to gain romantic experience for their manga. You can see the new character posters below.

Now That We Draw is a manga series by Kyu Takahata and Yuwji Kaba. It has been serialized in Hakusensha’s Young Animal seinen manga magazine since February 2023. Seven Seas Entertainment is publishing it in English, describing the story: Opposites attract in this hysterical rom-com about two high school manga artists who can’t catch a break! Dweeby high schooler Uehara Yuuki has created the perfect romantic comedy heroine—she’s bashful, airheaded, and completely chaste. When an editor at Uehara’s dream publisher coldly dismisses his manga story as trite and lacking realism, it sends Uehara into a spiral of despair that pushes him into the path of his bubbly, gorgeous classmate, Miyamoto Niina—an aspiring manga artist herself! Having gotten the similar feedback on her own manga, Miyamoto proposes she and Uehara engage in a fake relationship, since neither of them has any romantic experience. But Miyamoto is far from the perfect heroine Uehara’s concocted, and he certainly isn’t the cocky hero from her story either. Can their wacky relationship turn their manga dreams into reality, or will it lead to even more comic disasters?

title: WEBTOON Launches 1st Global Drop With The Warrior's Ballad
content:
WEBTOON Entertainment has launched its first "Global Drop" project with The Warrior's Ballad , releasing the fantasy webtoon simultaneously in nine languages on September 19.

Global Drop is a new initiative that releases highly anticipated new and returning webtoons in multiple languages without a time delay between regions. This marks the first time WEBTOON Entertainment has simultaneously launched an ongoing series across nine language services.

Written by Dodongpa, adapted by Namwoon, and drawn by Street Bard, The Warrior's Ballad is based on Dodongpa's web novel of the same name. It follows a powerful sword master who is reincarnated 100 years after his death as a boy named Ricardt.

The series launched in Korean, Japanese, English, French, German, Spanish, Thai, Indonesian, and Traditional Chinese.

Fans can read the English version on WEBTOON .

title: 'Kakunaru Ue wa' Reveals Additional Staff, First Promo for Winter 2027
content:
The official website for the television anime adaptation of Kyuu Takahata and Yuuji Kaba 's Kakunaru Ue wa ( Now That We Draw ) manga revealed additional staff, a character visual (pictured above), and the first promotional video on Thursday. The anime series will premiere in January 2027.

Staff Sub-character Design: Momoka Izumi ( Yofukashi no Uta animation director) Color Design: Yurie Matsuura ( Koi wa Futago de Warikirenai ) Art Director: Arei Saiga ( Kabushikigaisha Magi-Lumière background art) Director of Photography: Hayato Kifune (EOTA) ( Nippon Sangoku ) 3DCG: Masashi Watanabe ( Akebi-chan no Sailor-fuku ) Editing: Mai Hasegawa (editz) ( Blue Lock ) Sound Director: Fumiyuki Gou ( Tomodachi no Imouto ga Ore ni dake Uzai ) Sound Effects: Ryuuta Nakahara ( Jingai Kyoushitsu no Ningengirai Kyoushi ) Music: Yoshiaki Miura

Shunsuke Ishikawa ( Blue Lock: Episode Nagi ) is directing the anime at ROLL2 , with Deko Akao ( Witch Watch ) handling the series composition and script. Hiromi Nakagawa ( Shiro Seijo to Kuro Bokushi ) is designing the characters.

Takahata and Kaba began serializing the romantic comedy manga in Young Animal in February 2023. Hakusensha published the seventh volume on April 28, with the eighth volume went on sale on September 29.

Seven Seas Entertainment licensed the manga for English release in September 2024 and published the fifth volume on July 28, with the sixth volume is planned for a December 22 release.

title: Snowball Earth Manga Heads to Final Arc, Exceeds 1 Million Copies in Circulation
content:
Manga author Yuhiro Tsujitsugu announced on their X (formerly Twitter ) account on Thursday that their Snowball Earth manga has exceeded 1 million copies in circulation. Additionally, Tsujitsugu announced that the manga is starting its final arc. Tsujitsugu drew an illustration to celebrate the manga's 1 million milestone.

In the year 2025, huge beasts from beyond the galaxy attacked Earth. In the war that followed, humanity fought back with a giant robot named Yukio, piloted by Tetsuo Yabusame. As the massive alien swarm closed in on humanity's homeworld, Tetsuo and the Earth Defense Force deployed for the final battle with the invading horde. They lost… Yukio was destroyed in battle and Tetsuo survived in an escape pod. After eight years in cold sleep, the escape pod finally lands back on Earth. But when Tetsuo emerges he finds a world in ruins, entirely frozen beneath a blanket of ice and snow— Snowball Earth ! What happened to humanity, how did the planet freeze over, and will Tetsuo be able to keep his last promise to Yukio?

Tsujitsugu launched the manga in Shogakukan 's Monthly Spirits magazine in 2021. Shogakukan will publish the manga's 12th compiled book volume on September 30. Viz Media will publish the manga's 10th volume in English on December 15.

The manga's anime adaptation premiered on NTV 's extended Friday night programming block on April 3. Hulu streamed the anime as it aired. The anime is getting a second season.
